basic_info.description: Opportunities like this don't come often in Pacific Heights. For the first time in decades, this single-level Victorian residence is available offering a timeless blend of historic San Francisco charm & lifestyle convenience in one of the city's most prestigious neighborhoods. Inside, the entry hall opens to a generous living room & formal dining room leading into the bright kitchen. The adjacent two bedrooms & two baths are thoughtfully arranged: one bedroom has a full en-suite bath with a claw footed tub & the second full bath with shower over tub is accessed from the main hallway. At the rear, a sunny west-facing den opens directly to a light-filled garden with abundant plantings, including two mature lemon trees. The outdoor space is a true extension of the home - an inviting setting for entertaining, relaxing, or savoring morning coffee & afternoon wine. Beneath the main residence, a substantial street-level garage with ample storage space & a set-back one-car driveway add convenience today while leaving room for tomorrow's ideas. Move in now & enjoy the home with some cosmetic improvements or bring your own vision to create something extraordinary. This is more than a home - it's a rare offering in Pacific Heights & it won't last. Don't miss your chance to see it.
